summary: A one-expression literal sqlite_ prefix fix prevents unapproved schema objects hidden by the old LIKE wildcard from passing payer-recovery schema validation before owner acquisition. This result concerns only new empty private synthetic SQLite databases.
roadmap: P2 payer custody storage schema admission; not live pilot acceptance or a full backend requalification

change.cause: In SQL LIKE, underscore matches any one character. The old pattern therefore excluded sqlitex-style names, not only the reserved sqlite_ prefix.
change.baselineObservation: In a new empty V3 database the old source accepted a sqlitex_probe table plus sqlitex_owner_trigger; opening advanced owner_epoch 1->2 and inserted one synthetic marker. This is a local reproduction, not safe-store qualification.

initialFailure.sourceIdentifiedCause: The fixture supplied /compute but the unchanged custody-policy contract requires the exact /service-credit/v1/execute service path. The after hook also reported a namespace assertion because no database was created.
